ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast between approximately 90% low-intensity black pigmentation and 10% high-intensity white/tan focal points and tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black base layer. High-contrast white circular spots located in the mid-ventral regions of both lobes. Dense, irregular tan/white clusters mapped to the extreme lateral tips and parts of the upper leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible wide V-shaped central depression, approximately 120 degrees, with moderate depth relative to the fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular profile with frequent low-to-mid amplitude peaks and valleys; several distinct larger protrusions (5-15 pixels) located on the inner trailing edge of both lobes near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Smoothly convex curve initiating from the median notch and extending to the distal lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters, including distinct ring-like (hollow) patterns on the left lobe and solid white points on both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of thin, unaligned white linear marks, including a distinct diagonal abrasion on the right lobe and multiple vertical scratches on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustations (barnacle clusters) localized at both distal tips, creating jagged, irregular three-dimensional boundaries.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct hollow-ring white scars on the mid-left lobe surface.
